description: This PHP file defines an abstract class `Entry` within the `Todaymade\Daux\Tree` namespace. The class encapsulates common properties and methods for tree nodes in a documentation or content tree structure, such as managing URIs, titles, parent-child relationships, and paths.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: An abstract base class representing an item in a hierarchical tree structure, with properties like title, name, URI, parent, and path, and methods to manipulate and retrieve these properties, as well as methods to navigate the tree.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a tree entry with a parent directory, URI, and optional file info, registering itself as a child of the parent.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entry if set, or null otherwise.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the entry.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the entry.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI of the entry, updating parent-child relationships accordingly.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the entry if set, or null otherwise.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the entry.

methods.name: getNameForSort
methods.description: Provides a fallback string (name, title, or URI) used for sorting purposes.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent directory of the entry, if any.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Returns an array of all parent directories up to the root.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the stored filesystem path of the entry.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Computes and returns the relative path from the root directory to this entry.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL path to this entry based on its parent hierarchy.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns an associative array summarizing the entry's properties.

methods.name: isHotPath
methods.description: Delegates to the parent to determine if this entry is part of a hot path, useful for debugging or navigation highlighting.
